output.summary: An annual flowering plant native to Eurasia and now naturalized worldwide. Its sprawling stems bear a single line of hairs that switches sides at the nodes, along with small white flowers. Its leaves are eaten as a vegetable, often raw in salads, though some varieties or similar species may be too fibrous.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves are eaten, often raw in salads; some varieties or similar species may be too fibrous, and use is not advised during pregnancy or breastfeeding.
